cohort: A total of 1976 high-risk pregnant women were enrolled between 2015 and 2017, all receiving a 75g oral glucose tolerance test during 24-30 gestational weeks.
finding: Fasting glucose at 24-30 gestational weeks was strongly associated with total and individual adverse pregnancy outcomes among high-risk pregnant women.
mod_finding: Primary cesarean section was identified as one of the adverse pregnancy outcomes significantly associated with maternal fasting glucose levels.
